/memories/session-01.md:L3: description: Session 1 on 2023-03-23 between Calvin and Dave.
/memories/session-01.md:L9: Speakers: Calvin, Dave
/memories/session-01.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! Nice to meet you! How's it going since we talked?
/memories/session-01.md:L15: Dave: Hey Calvin! Nice to meet you too! Things have been going well since we last talked. I attended this awesome event recently. It was like a car lover's paradise! They had so many classic cars on show, I was in awe. I even had the opportunity to speak with some of the owners and hear their fascinating stories. It was super inspiring. What about you? Anything exciting happening in your life lately?
/memories/session-01.md:L18: Calvin: That event sounds great! Something really exciting happened to me - I just had a big life change! Here's my new mansion - pretty cool huh?
/memories/session-01.md:L25: Calvin: I'm so excited to learn about Japanese culture and get a chance to expand.
/memories/session-01.md:L28: Dave: Wow, Calvin, learning about new cultures is awesome! Have you ever been to Japan?
/memories/session-01.md:L31: Calvin: Never been there before. Fascinated by the traditions and can't wait to get a taste of the culture.
/memories/session-01.md:L37: Calvin: I'm heading there next month. I'll be staying in such a nice place while I'm there.
/memories/session-01.md:L46: Calvin: Wow, my agent found me this awesome place, so thankful!
/memories/session-01.md:L52: Calvin: I'm planning to explore the city, try out different local cuisines, and perhaps collaborate with musicians in the area.
/memories/session-01.md:L58: Calvin: I'm gonna be in Japan for a few months then off to Boston! I can't wait!
/memories/session-01.md:L65: Calvin: No, I've never been in that park. Looks like a chill spot. I'll definitely check it out when I'm back. Appreciate the tip!
/memories/session-01.md:L71: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! If I need any help, I'll be sure to let you know. Stay safe!
/memories/session-02.md:L3: description: Session 2 on 2023-03-26 between Calvin and Dave.
/memories/session-02.md:L9: Speakers: Calvin, Dave
/memories/session-02.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave, been a few days, so I wanted to let you in on some cool news.  I just got a new car and it's amazing! Finally owning a luxury car was a dream come true and I'm so stoked.
/memories/session-02.md:L15: Dave: Woohoo, Calvin! Congrats on the new car! How's it driving?
/memories/session-02.md:L18: Calvin: Nice car! It's an amazing ride - super smooth and real powerful. Like a rockstar behind the wheel! Thanks, man!
/memories/session-02.md:L21: Dave: Wow, Calvin! Owning something like this must feel amazing. Is this your first one? Show me a pic! What's it called?
/memories/session-02.md:L24: Calvin: Woohoo! I finally got myself this beauty. Here's a pic from yesterday when I took it for a ride. Can't believe I'm actually driving it. Definitely what I deserve after all this hard work. Every time I step in, it's like an adrenaline rush!
/memories/session-02.md:L28: Dave: Calvin, that car looks awesome! You must feel amazing every time you get inside! You deserved it - congrats buddy!
/memories/session-02.md:L31: Calvin: Woah, I'm on cloud nine! Hard work pays off. What's up with you, Dave?
/memories/session-02.md:L34: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Doing good. Last weekend, I went to a music festival in Boston - it was awesome! So many cool bands playing and the atmosphere was electric. I love music, it reminded me why I love it. Here's a pic, take a look.
/memories/session-02.md:L38: Calvin: Wow, sounds like a blast! Which one was your favorite?
/memories/session-02.md:L45: Calvin: Cool! Lovin' Aerosmith.
/memories/session-02.md:L52: Calvin: Cool, Dave! Seeing your favorite singers live must have been wild! Did you get a chance to hang out with them after the show?
/memories/session-02.md:L58: Calvin: Yeah, it's always a dream to see your favorites doing their thing! So glad you got to experience that.
/memories/session-02.md:L61: Dave: Thanks, Calvin! Yeah, it was an incredible experience. So, anything new happening in your life?
/memories/session-02.md:L64: Calvin: Got a new ride and wrote some new tunes - had a few studio sessions last week and I'm excited to collaborate. Can't wait to share it with everyone!
/memories/session-02.md:L67: Dave: Cool, Calvin! Looking forward to hearing your new tunes. Keep me updated on how your collaborations go!
/memories/session-02.md:L70: Calvin: Yeah, no worries! I'll definitely let you know how it goes. Cheers!
/memories/session-02.md:L73: Dave: Enjoy the collaborations, Calvin! Stay safe!
/memories/session-02.md:L76: Calvin: Thanks, Dave! Gonna have fun and stay safe with it. Bye!
/memories/session-03.md:L3: description: Session 3 on 2023-04-20 between Calvin and Dave.
/memories/session-03.md:L9: Speakers: Calvin, Dave
/memories/session-03.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! Long time no see. I just went to an awesome music thingy in Tokyo - so cool!
/memories/session-03.md:L15: Dave: Hey Calvin! Great to hear from you. How was the music thingy in Tokyo? See any cool bands?
/memories/session-03.md:L18: Calvin: Hey Dave! The festival in Tokyo was awesome! Didn't see any bands, but met lots of talented artists and industry people. Totally enriching!
/memories/session-03.md:L21: Dave: Wow, Calvin, sounds great! What did you learn from it?

/memories/session-02.md:L49: [Image caption: a photo of two people on stage with guitars and a microphone]
/memories/session-06.md:L18: Calvin: Hey Dave, not everything has been going smoothly. I had an incident last week where my place got flooded, but thankfully, I managed to save my music gear and favorite microphone. It's been tough, but I'm staying positive and looking forward to getting everything fixed up.
/memories/session-06.md:L21: Dave: Man, that's rough, Calvin. Sorry to hear about that. But I'm glad you could save your music gear and mic - those are the important things. Stay positive, pal. Anything I can do to help?
/memories/session-09.md:L12: Calvin: Hi Dave! Nice to hear from you. Since last chat, some things have happened. I had a lil car accident last Friday, kinda upsetting but no one was hurt. I've been dealing with insurance and repairs - taking up a lot of time and energy. Look at this photo!
/memories/session-09.md:L16: Dave: Sorry to hear about the car accident, Calvin. I'm glad to hear that nobody was hurt. Dealing with insurance and repairs can definitely be time-consuming and draining. Have you encountered any issues in the insurance process so far?
/memories/session-14.md:L44: [Image caption: a photo of a car with a broken engine in the woods]
/memories/session-18.md:L12: Calvin: Hey Dave! Sorry it took me so long to get back to you. Crazy times since we talked! My album finally dropped on the 11th and it was a wild feeling. Everyone's been loving it and it's motivated me to keep going.
/memories/session-22.md:L27: Dave: Thanks Calvin! I've spent a lot of time and effort on it. It's not just a hobby, it's a passion. It's like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress. When I was little I'd spend hours in my dad's garage, tinkering with engines - it was like my own sanctuary. Now I'm lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome.
/memories/session-22.md:L30: Calvin: Wow, Dave, that's amazing. Bringing broken things back to life is so satisfying. Working on cars can be a real escape from reality, and I understand that feeling. Doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal, right? Keep going with it, it's really inspiring.
/memories/session-23.md:L43: Dave: Yeah, Calvin! The crowd had such a buzz. Music brings people together in such an amazing way, and it's just like when I'm fixing up things. I love the feeling of taking something broken and making it whole again. That's why I keep doing what I do.
/memories/session-23.md:L46: Calvin: Yeah, Dave! Music and repairing things are so fulfilling and satisfying. Seeing something go from broken to whole is incredible. You're making a difference too - it's amazing. Keep it up, friend.
/memories/session-25.md:L55: Dave: Ever since I was ten, I've been fascinated with how machines work. I found an old car in a neighbor's garage and asked if I could fix it. That's when my love for car engineering began! I enjoyed transforming it from broken-down to high-running, and that sense of accomplishment made me hooked—so I've been working on cars ever since.
